Label: Requested Loan Amount
Description: Dollar amount requested by the applicant on the application.

Label: Stated Annual Income
Description: Annual gross income stated by the applicant on the application.

Label: Debt-to-Income Ratio
Description: Calculated ratio of total monthly debt obligations to gross monthly income, expressed as a percentage.

Label: Loan-to-Value Ratio
Description: Ratio of the loan amount to the appraised value of the collateral, expressed as a percentage.

Label: Loan Term (Months)
Description: Requested or approved loan term in months.

Label: Application Channel
Description: Channel through which the application was submitted. 1=Branch, 2=Online, 3=Mobile, 4=Phone, 5=Dealer/Broker, 6=Direct Mail.

Label: Existing Customer Indicator
Description: Whether the applicant has an existing relationship with the institution. 0=New Customer, 1=Existing Customer.

Label: Months of Customer Relationship
Description: Duration in months of the customer's relationship with the institution (0 for new customers).

Label: Number of Existing Accounts
Description: Count of active accounts the applicant currently holds with the institution.

Label: Average Checking Balance Last 3 Months
Description: Average daily checking account balance over the past 3 months (existing customers only).

Label: Number of NSF Events Last 6 Months
Description: Count of non-sufficient funds (NSF) or overdraft events in the past 6 months on internal deposit accounts.

Label: Direct Deposit Indicator
Description: Whether the applicant has recurring direct deposit to an internal account. 0=No, 1=Yes.
Special Values: 0=No Direct Deposit; 1=Has Direct Deposit; -1=No Deposit Account; -7=Not Available

Label: Employment Length (Years)
Description: Self-reported number of years at current employer.

Label: Housing Status
Special Values: 1=Own Outright; 2=Rent; 3=Own with Mortgage; 4=Living with Family; 5=Other; -1=Not Provided; -7=Not Available

Label: Previous Applications Last 12 Months
Description: Count of prior applications submitted to the institution in the last 12 months.

Label: Internal Behavioral Score
Description: Proprietary behavioral score based on internal account performance history. Higher scores indicate lower risk.

Label: Loan Purpose
Description: Purpose of the loan as stated in the application. Codes vary by portfolio.
Special Values: 1=Purchase (New); 2=Purchase (Used); 3=Refinance; 4=Lease Buyout; 5=Debt Consolidation; 6=Home Improvement; 7=Medical; 8=Education; 9=Vacation; 10=Major Purchase; 11=Business; 12=Moving/Relocation; 13=Wedding; 14=Other; -1=Not Stated; -7=Not Available

Label: Co-Borrower Present
Description: Indicator for whether a co-borrower or co-applicant is present on the application. 0=No, 1=Yes.

Label: Application State
Description: U.S. state of the applicant's primary address (2-letter FIPS code mapped to numeric 1-56).
